title: sign() uses MalformedInput for MIME boundary collision, wrong semantic
description: sign.rs line 351 returns SmimeError::MalformedInput for the case where the derived boundary string appears in the content_mime input. The MalformedInput variant is documented as 'structurally malformed CMS input' — but boundary collision is not a CMS structural issue, it is a property of the caller-supplied MIME content. SmimeError::Other would be a better fit, or a dedicated variant. This is cosmetic: it cannot cause incorrect behavior, only slightly confusing diagnostics.
close_reason: Opinion: MalformedInput is the closest available variant for boundary collision; semantics are acceptable pre-1.0.
